summary: Rulings F1–F5 are applied (AnsibleSpecs 2a75881). The go-live pushes and P8's hook now cite D3/D6/F1. P4 lists the ten jobs of the five ModernAppTemplate repos as skipped, AaC jobs included, and P6 and V07 lose the monorepo reference file. P1 reads Manage hooks from /manage/configure (on today). P2 ships no guide page. J11's exceptions are proposed, not settled (P4, P5, V06). The dry run parses all 11 phases.
